scripts.build: env -u VIRTUAL_ENV uv run --isolated --with-editable '..[viz,ros,rerun,viser]' python build/build.py
scripts.test: env -u VIRTUAL_ENV uv run --isolated --with-editable '..[viz,ros,rerun,viser]' python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && pnpm run test && wrangler deploy
